evidence: This describes the experimental design and sample size used in the study.

evidence: This is a conclusion drawn from the combined findings of ketanserin blockade and gene expression correlation.

claim: Disorders of perception and the form and content of thought are important contributors to the global burden of disease.
source: Disorders of perception and the form and content of thought are important contributors to the global burden of disease (Murray et al., 2012).
evidence: This statement is supported by a citation to Murray et al., 2012.

claim: LSD is a psychedelic drug with predominantly agonist activity at serotonin 5-HT2A/C, −1A/B, −6, and −7 and dopamine D2 and D1 receptors.
source: In particular, lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) is a psychedelic drug with predominantly agonist activity at serotonin (5-HT)2A/C, −1A/B, −6, and −7 and dopamine D2 and D1 receptors (R). Its administration produces characteristic alterations in perception, mood, thought, and the sense of self (Marona-Lewicka et al., 2002; Nichols, 2004).

claim: Human research on LSD neurobiology stalled in the late 1960s.

claim: GBC computes the connectivity of every voxel in the brain with all other voxels and summarizes that in a single value.
source: In essence, GBC computes the connectivity of every voxel in the brain with all other voxels and summarizes that in a single value.
